target: Derive the exact complete-tail-block cube incident-face budget and quantify the joint observable-support and time-window convergence certificate from N1.
model: Exactly N1 canonical summable full-link SU(2) selected-strip/free representation on the nonnegative cubic octant. Infinite-volume H_q is unchanged; only the finite support of bounded observables may now depend on q.
graph_boundary: For integer L>=1, take all complete I1 tail-ownership blocks b=(i,j,k), 0<=i,j,k<L. A block owns all positive links with tails (4i+r,2j+s,k), 0<=r<4, 0<=s<2, including outgoing links. E_L is all 24 L^3 owned links. The cover F_L includes the whole selected strip plus all free factors in each block. This is a complete tail-block cube, not a clipped vertex box.

definitions.D_L(q): sum over every omitted face whose links meet E_L of q^(base_x+base_y+base_z)/24, counting each face once, even if some other links leave the cube.
definitions.profile: B(q),tau_q,eta,gbar,sigma_q,d_q are exactly N1/M1/M2, unchanged. Profile B(q) is distinct from observable B_q.
definitions.observables: For each q, A_q and B_q are bounded complex gauge-invariant operators; B_q supported in F_L(q), A_q any finite complete factor support; sup_q ||A_q||||B_q|| finite. No arbitrary domain-preservation premise.
definitions.support_protocol: L(q)=max(1,floor(ell*(1-q)^(-beta))), ell>0 and beta>=0. At beta=0 use its fixed integer L; for beta>0 L diverges. ell,beta dimensionless observation-design parameters.
definitions.time_protocol: T_q=(hbar/alpha)*C*(1-q)^(-gamma), fixed C>0,gamma>=0; optional fixed-L endpoint correction divides this by [log(1/(1-q))]^k with k>0.
definitions.physical_scales: Fixed E_star>0, alpha/E_star>0,hbar>0,eta in (0,1), lattice spacing a>0. Tail-block cube physical side lengths 4aL,2aL,aL; growth is observed region, not a continuum or homogeneous limit.

required: Prove exact complete-factor ownership and face-incidence boundary characterization for every L, then derive D_L(q) in closed form. A finite enumeration alone is insufficient.
Apply the N1 strong-integral proof pointwise in q and its trace-state bound uniformly to this moving observable family, identifying precisely the certificate condition involving T_q tau_q D_L(q).
Determine regimes beta<1,beta=1,beta>1, including floor effects, gamma boundary and fixed L. State necessity only for vanishing of this specified nonnegative certificate, not actual correlations.
For fixed L examine logarithmically shortened gamma=3 windows and the unshortened endpoint as checks, without counting these substitutions as separate research loops.

Independent exact geometry/arithmetic controls capable of rejecting clipping outgoing links, omitting crossing faces, replacing finite budget by its infinite sum, or claiming actual nonconvergence from an upper bound.
Retain model scales and complex observables; no state/gap/representation transfer.
proposed_not_accepted: An exact finite weighted face sum may replace the crude link count and determine a joint support/time certificate; its closed formula and regime boundaries must be derived independently.
acceptance: Accept exact geometry and a justified joint support/time sufficient theorem with certificate-only obstructions, or record the concrete unresolved step. No claim of actual endpoint nonconvergence.
next_loop: Reassess O/P after N2 skeptical review; Q/R remain unselected.
